title: Daily arXiv Physics — Friday, 30 October 2026 announcement batch
global_caveat: This is an inferred ordering, not an official arXiv trending chart. Citation evidence is sparse for papers announced about a day ago, so these are notable recent papers rather than measured popularity leaders.

sections.title: High-Fidelity Universal Quantum Gates in a Cryogenic Atom Array
sections.abstract: The authors demonstrate a universal gate set in a cryogenic cesium atom array, reporting 99.970(2)% single-qubit fidelity and 99.76(8)% raw two-qubit entangling-gate fidelity.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: The unusually concrete gate benchmark drew same-day coverage from Quantum Zeitgeist; a universal gate set in a 4 K atom array and the measured fidelity/error budget provide a clear, independently discussable platform result.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report 99.970(2)% single-qubit Clifford fidelity and 99.76(8)% raw CZ fidelity, using direct single-photon coupling to a Rydberg P state; they attribute the main measured error to atomic motion rather than Rydberg decay.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; randomized benchmarking and coherent control in a 4 K cryogenic 133Cs optical-tweezer array
sections.unique_caveat: The quoted entangling-gate number is a raw two-qubit fidelity, not a logical or fault-tolerant system result; atomic motion remains the dominant measured infidelity source.

sections.title: Complex Organic Molecules in Protostars with ALMA Spectral Surveys (COMPASS) VIII. First interstellar detection of fully deuterated methyl cyanide
sections.abstract: ALMA observations of L1551 IRS5 reveal all three deuterated methyl-cyanide isotopologs, including the first reported interstellar detection of fully deuterated CD3CN.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: The first-detection result was covered by Astrobiology on announcement day, and the arXiv record states acceptance for Astronomy & Astrophysics.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report CD3CN toward the northern component of L1551 IRS5 and a rising D/H ratio across its methyl-cyanide isotopologs; they discuss cold grain-surface formation while retaining a warm gas-phase or timing alternative.
sections.evidence_type: observational; ALMA COMPASS 12-m array spectral survey and LTE radiative-transfer/column-density analysis
sections.unique_caveat: The measurement concerns one protostellar system and assumes LTE; the authors note that no chemical model yet follows methyl-cyanide deuteration through CD3CN, so the formation pathway is unresolved.

sections.title: PRISMS GHZ8: Evidence for a Young Burst and Potential Merger Activity at z=10.23
sections.abstract: JWST spectroscopy and imaging of the z=10.23 galaxy GHZ8 reveal two close components and support a young star-forming episode, while a merger-triggered burst remains tentative.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: JWST/MIRI reports approximately 5σ Hβ–[O III] and 4σ Hα line detections, with NIRCam resolving components only about 600 pc apart; outside expert coverage was not verified at this snapshot.
sections.claimed_result: The authors infer either a short, recent star-formation burst or less than 50 Myr of continuous activity in GHZ8-main, and estimate a high ionizing-photon escape fraction for the very blue companion.
sections.evidence_type: observational; JWST/MIRI LRS spectroscopy, NIRCam imaging, NIRSpec/prism data, and spectro-photometric SED fitting
sections.unique_caveat: The merger-induced-burst interpretation is explicitly provisional and needs deeper imaging or spatially resolved kinematics; inferred stellar properties also depend on SED modelling and calibration.

sections.title: Entanglement diagnostics of stochastic-resetting steady states: theory and measurement on superconducting qubits
sections.abstract: The authors analyze entanglement in stochastically reset transverse-field Ising chains and report IBM superconducting-processor entropy measurements that track noiseless predictions, while concurrence is generally lower.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Independent discussion in Quantum Zeitgeist and listing by arXiv Signals, together with a three-way physics cross-list and hardware/theory comparison.
sections.claimed_result: The authors show that the Jensen gap between trajectory-averaged and averaged-state entropy equals Holevo information about time since reset; they also report entropy agreement with noiseless IBM-hardware predictions without fitting, alongside suppressed concurrence.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; analytical two-qubit results, exact calculations for chains up to 12 sites, and measurements on an IBM superconducting processor
sections.unique_caveat: Hardware concurrence falls below the ideal prediction and is only captured phenomenologically by a fitted depolarizing-noise model; the exact chain sizes and reset-probability range are limited.

sections.title: NEOPIC: A Neural Operator Framework for Particle-based Kinetic Plasma Simulations
sections.abstract: NEOPIC learns the electric-field operator directly on particle measures without mesh deposition and is tested on electrostatic kinetic-plasma benchmarks with error and complexity analysis.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Public implementation and analysis-script repositories, external Researchia synopsis, and a computational-physics/plasma/ML cross-list.
sections.claimed_result: The authors prove a representation-equivalence property and derive an error decomposition; simulations across several electrostatic benchmarks show one model trained from multiple reference methods remains stable up to twice its training time window.
sections.evidence_type: computational; Landau damping, two-stream and bump-on-tail instabilities, a cyclotron mini-app, and a Penning trap
sections.unique_caveat: Demonstrations are limited to collisionless electrostatic plasma; electromagnetic, collisional, and broader production-code performance are not established by the reported tests.

sections.title: First search for sidereal and annual modulation of Z-pole asymmetries with the recovered SLD data set
sections.abstract: A time-resolved reanalysis of recovered SLD Z-pole collision data finds no sidereal, solar-diurnal, or annual modulation and places limits on selected anisotropy and Lorentz-violation parameters.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Cross-listed between experiment and phenomenology; applies new time-resolved analysis to recovered public collision data and validates the null result on a later-released run.
sections.claimed_result: The author reports a statistical 95% C.L. bound of 0.0086 on the sidereal first-harmonic asymmetry amplitude in the main sample and a null check on 229,833 later-run events; the paper maps selected results to Standard-Model-Extension coefficients at leading order.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; archival reanalysis of polarized SLD/SLC data, including 385,583 selected hadronic Z decays from 1996–1998
sections.unique_caveat: The quoted amplitude bound is statistical and the mapping to SME coefficients is model-dependent and leading order; some coefficient results exclude finite bands rather than simple upper limits.

sections.title: UNIONS: Red and blue alignments of DESI DR1 galaxies
sections.abstract: Cross-correlating DESI DR1 spectroscopy with UNIONS weak-lensing shapes, the authors measure intrinsic galaxy alignments and find a 3.3σ tangential alignment for massive blue galaxies.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Combines two major survey products over up to 2,400 square degrees and reports a quantitative result relevant to weak-lensing systematics; cosmology/galaxy cross-listing is an additional signal.
sections.claimed_result: The authors find red galaxies radially aligned and massive blue BGS galaxies tangentially aligned at 3.3σ; at current precision, the data do not prefer TATT over NLA.
sections.evidence_type: observational; DESI DR1 spectroscopy cross-correlated with UNIONS weak-lensing shapes and fitted with NLA and TATT alignment models
sections.unique_caveat: The blue-galaxy alignment is a 3.3σ result in the analyzed sample, and the data do not yet distinguish the two tested alignment prescriptions.

sections.title: Electric field control of anisotropic spin traffic between spin-filtering and magnon-scattering in a layered antiferromagnet
sections.abstract: A dual-gate CrSBr field-effect transistor reveals anisotropic magnetotransport whose sign and magnitude are governed more strongly by displacement field than by carrier doping.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Four-way cross-listing spans materials, transport, computation, and quantum physics; the result combines dual-gate device measurements with ab initio calculations and an effective spin-circuit model.
sections.claimed_result: The authors attribute positive and negative magnetoresistance components to interlayer and intralayer spin-dependent transport, with displacement field the more effective control parameter in their CrSBr device.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; dual-gate CrSBr transistor transport interpreted with ab initio calculations and a spin-circuit model
sections.unique_caveat: The mechanisms are model-assisted interpretations of this material/device system; transfer to other layered antiferromagnets remains a proposal.

sections.title: Chiral p-Wave Superconductivity Proximate to a Fractional Chern Insulator and a Topological Charge Density Wave in a Moiré Chern Band
sections.abstract: Exact diagonalization and weak-coupling theory for a twisted-MoTe₂ moiré Chern band predict chiral p-wave pairing near fractional-Chern-insulator and topological charge-density-wave regimes.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Cross-listed across superconductivity, mesoscopic physics, and strongly correlated electrons; exact diagonalization and a separate weak-coupling argument support a concrete, experimentally relevant prediction.
sections.claimed_result: In the modeled spin-polarized band, the authors find pair binding over roughly 0.7 < filling < 0.77, chiral p-wave correlations, finite superfluid stiffness, and a BdG Chern number of −1.
sections.evidence_type: theoretical; exact diagonalization and Kohn–Luttinger weak-coupling analysis of a twisted-MoTe₂ moiré Chern-band model
sections.unique_caveat: The predicted phase depends on a specific model and finite-size calculations; the preprint does not report an experimental detection of chiral p-wave superconductivity.
